verdict.rationale: cubic exposes some functionality programmatically — an Analytics API for PR-level metrics, an MCP server for reading review findings, requesting reviews, and even managing subscription/seats, and a CLI for local review — but there is no evidence of a comprehensive public REST/GraphQL API covering all UI actions (e.g., configuring custom agents, cubic.yaml settings, wiki management), and probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd. missing for 10: a full documented API (OpenAPI spec) covering configuration, custom agents, wiki, and auto-approval policy management equivalent to UI capabilities.
